item.text: The build helper ignores real environment variables and always reads `.env`, which is why the isolated verification value had no effect. That conflicts with the project’s documented environment-variable setup, so I’m making the narrow compatibility fix: honor `process.env` first and retain the existing `.env` fallback for normal local use. This lets the review build run without touching the user’s file.
